purpose: Schema-first Payment Master SRS inputs with future specification upgrade tracking metadata

strategy_summary.core_pattern: spec watcher -> candidate schema delta -> SDNF gates -> SRS lineage -> payload regression -> approved schema version
strategy_summary.why: This prevents silent overwrites when providers/standards add fields, deprecate fields, or change type/constraint semantics.

recommended_folder_layout.schemas_current: approved schema descriptor versions used by runtime compliance
recommended_folder_layout.schemas_candidate: newly detected spec changes not yet approved
recommended_folder_layout.payloads_regression: payload examples used to test old and new schema behavior

INAmex.canonical_spec_strategy: Track American Express Data Security Operating Policy and PCI DSS documents rather than a public Amex payment-object JSON schema. Treat card-data fields as card/PAN/expiry/CVV/cardholder security-governed descriptors.
upgrade_triggers: new/changed policy for Cardholder Data or Sensitive Authentication Data

PPVisa.canonical_spec_strategy: Track ISO 8583/card-message common data elements and PCI storage/security rules. Treat Visa-like payload as inferred card payload unless official Visa integration docs are supplied.

Mastercard.canonical_spec_strategy: Track ISO 8583 Maintenance Agency artifacts for base field evolution; treat Mastercard-specific usage as network/profile overlay unless proprietary Mastercard docs are supplied.
upgrade_triggers: new version mapping in convergence document

ISO20022.canonical_spec_strategy: Track ISO 20022 catalogue, message definitions, change requests, external code sets, variants, and supplementary data. Use message id/version such as pacs.008.001.xx as version anchor.
upgrade_triggers: approved change request impacting pacs/payment fields

Plaid.canonical_spec_strategy: Track Plaid API versioning and changelog. Additive fields can be ingested as candidate attributes; backwards-incompatible changes require schema version fork and regression.

Razorpay.canonical_spec_strategy: Track Razorpay API changelog, Payments changelog, and API reference/versioning notes. Since Razorpay states APIs are backwards-compatible and deprecations receive warnings, treat deprecations as lifecycle flags in SRS lineage.

Stripe.canonical_spec_strategy: Track Stripe changelog/API upgrades and PaymentIntent object docs. Stripe changelog explicitly tracks API changes and upgrades; API versions and breaking changes should trigger schema version updates.

UPI.canonical_spec_strategy: Track NPCI UPI circulars/notifications and UPI technology specifications. Use circular numbers and API version in URL/path/header as version anchors.

watch_sources.label: NPCI support article for UPI circular path

upgrade_triggers: new limit/compliance rule affecting payload validation

upgrade_decision_matrix.new_optional_field: minor version; create candidate attribute; auto-defer until semantic family and evidence pass
upgrade_decision_matrix.new_required_field: major or minor-breaking; create candidate delta; runtime compliance must not auto-allow until reviewed
upgrade_decision_matrix.field_type_change: major; fork schema version and run payload regression
upgrade_decision_matrix.constraint_pattern_change: major if stricter, minor if additive/relaxed; run payload regression
upgrade_decision_matrix.enum_addition: minor; add allowed value but keep PONF family unchanged
upgrade_decision_matrix.field_deprecation: patch/minor; mark deprecated; retain legacy mapping until evidence supports removal
upgrade_decision_matrix.semantic_reclassification: major; run AANF/RRNF/PONF/CMNF gates and lineage justification
